description: 1. Agent reads SKILL.md and identifies the fetch_holidays.py script under skills/china-holidays/scripts/. 2. For 2025, the agent recognizes the phrase '重新从官方网络渠道获取最新数据' maps to the --force flag trigger phrases defined in the skill ('重新从网络获取', '强制更新缓存', etc.), and runs: `python scripts/fetch_holidays.py --year 2025 --force`. This overwrites the stale draft cache in assets/2025.md with the correct authoritative data (8 days, starting Jan 28 除夕). 3. For 2026, the agent uses the cache-first (default, no --force) strategy: `python scripts/fetch_holidays.py --year 2026`, correctly reading the cached 9-day schedule starting Feb 15. 4. Agent extracts 春节 details from both outputs: 2025 = 8 days (Jan 28–Feb 4, makeup: Jan 26 & Feb 8), 2026 = 9 days (Feb 15–23, makeup: Feb 14 & Feb 28). 5. Agent produces a valid spring_festival_comparison.json containing both years' 春节 data with the correct authoritative figures and a cross-year comparison.
